messages.content: Hi, saya from Interconnect Billing team Subang Jaya. We need to migrate semua interconnect agreement legacy CDR records dari Oracle ICB v9 ke new MyTel ICB v12 sebelum end of Q2. Boleh tolong init migration plan?
Good morning, Sir. Thank you for contacting the migration helpdesk. I will initialise a new migration plan from Oracle ICB v9 to MyTel ICB v12 for you. Please hold on for a moment.

messages.name: init_migration_plan
messages.content: {"migration_plan_id": "mp-icb-v9v12-7720", "status": "created", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:42:11+08:00", "estimated_entities": {"interconnect_agreement": 184, "settlement_record": 26840, "rate_card": 312, "cdr_summary": 1842300}}

Plan `mp-icb-v9v12-7720` created. Estimated 184 agreements, 26,840 settlement records, 312 rate cards, and 1.84M CDR summaries. The next step is defining the field mapping. Would you like me to proceed with that, Sir?

Yes, define mapping. Most fields are 1-to-1 tapi `peer_operator_code` di v9 perlu lookup convert ke `carrier_id` v12. Boleh setup transform tu? And `rate_effective_from` v9 string to v12 ISO timestamp.
Understood, Sir. I will define the mapping with the lookup and ISO conversion transforms.

function.name: define_migration_mapping
function.arguments: {"migration_plan_id": "mp-icb-v9v12-7720", "entity_type": "interconnect_agreement", "field_mappings": [{"source_field": "peer_operator_code", "target_field": "carrier_id", "transform": {"kind": "lookup", "lookup_table": "ref_carrier_code_to_id_v12", "on_missing": "reject"}}, {"source_field": "rate_effective_from", "target_field": "effective_from", "transform": {"kind": "datetime_parse", "input_format": "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss", "input_timezone": "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur", "output_format": "iso8601"}}, {"source_field": "agreement_id", "target_field": "agreement_id", "transform": {"kind": "passthrough"}}, {"source_field": "contract_type", "target_field": "agreement_type", "transform": {"kind": "value_map", "value_map": {"BL": "bilateral", "UN": "unilateral", "MX": "mixed"}}}], "validation_rules": [{"rule_id": "v1-carrier-resolves", "description": "carrier_id must resolve in v12 registry", "severity": "critical"}]}

messages.name: define_migration_mapping
messages.content: {"mapping_id": "map-icb-ia-9981", "migration_plan_id": "mp-icb-v9v12-7720", "entity_type": "interconnect_agreement", "fields_defined": 4, "validation_rules": 1, "saved_at": "2026-05-21T09:43:00+08:00"}
Mapping `map-icb-ia-9981` saved with 4 field mappings and the critical carrier_id validation rule. Shall I validate the source data and run a transformation preview, Sir?
Yes, validate dulu source data, sample 500 records dulu. Then run transformation preview. Saya nak tahu kalau ada carrier code yang tak resolved.
Certainly, Sir. I will run both validation and a preview transformation in parallel.

messages.name: validate_source_data
messages.content: {"validation_id": "val-icb-44012", "entity_type": "interconnect_agreement", "sampled": 500, "passed": 487, "failed": 13, "issues": [{"check": "reference_integrity", "count": 9, "details": "peer_operator_code values [DGT_LEGACY, AXTL_X, PMD2] not present in ref_carrier_code_to_id_v12"}, {"check": "null_constraints", "count": 4, "details": "rate_effective_from is null for 4 records (agreement_ids: ia-44021, ia-44089, ia-44192, ia-44301)"}]}

messages.name: run_transformation_preview
messages.content: {"preview_id": "prv-icb-77110", "preview_size": 50, "transformed": 44, "rejected": 6, "rejection_summary": {"missing_carrier_code": 5, "datetime_parse_error": 1}, "sample_outputs": [{"agreement_id": "ia-10001", "carrier_id": "crr-celcom-v12", "agreement_type": "bilateral", "effective_from": "2024-03-15T00:00:00+08:00"}], "warnings": ["6/50 rejected — investigate lookup gaps before bulk migration"]}

Validation and preview results, Sir:

- **Validation:** 487/500 passed. 9 records have peer_operator_codes (`DGT_LEGACY`, `AXTL_X`, `PMD2`) not in v12 carrier registry; 4 have null `rate_effective_from`.
- **Preview:** 44/50 transformed, 6 rejected (5 missing lookup, 1 datetime parse error).

Recommended: either backfill the missing carrier_id mappings into v12 registry, or add explicit value_map entries before migrating. Would you like to record this and request approval to proceed?

Hmm, those 3 legacy codes I'll discuss with the carrier team. Tapi can we add a comment to the plan first, document the gaps? And request approval from billing director, ID `usr-bd-tan-09`, for proceeding with 181 agreements (skip 3).
Of course, Sir. I will record the comment and raise the approval request in parallel.

function.name: add_interconnect_migration_comment
function.arguments: {"target_id": "mp-icb-v9v12-7720", "comment": {"author_type": "human", "author_id": "usr-bill-ravi-12", "message": "Validation shows 3 legacy carrier codes (DGT_LEGACY, AXTL_X, PMD2) unmapped in v12 registry, affecting 9 agreements. Pending carrier team backfill. 4 agreements with null effective_from to be excluded pending data fix. Plan to migrate 181 agreements (184 - 3 excluded carriers).", "visibility": "internal", "category": "data_quality"}}

function.arguments: {"subject": {"kind": "migration_plan", "target_id": "mp-icb-v9v12-7720", "change_summary": "Approve migration of 181 active interconnect agreements (out of 184) from Oracle ICB v9 to MyTel ICB v12. 3 deferred pending legacy carrier code mapping."}}

Comment `cmt-icb-55301` and approval request `appr-icb-7701` raised, routed to billing director.
Director just approved. Pakai decide_interconnect_migration_approval, decided_by `usr-bd-tan-09`. Lepas tu start migration execution untuk 181 agreement tu, batch size 25 supaya manageable.
Understood, Sir. I will record the approval and start the migration execution.

Approved and execution `exec-icb-9981` is now running (8 batches, 181 entities). Shall I monitor progress, Sir?
Yes, get me migration status and list of batches so far. Saya nak tengok mana yang failed.
Right away, Sir.

Status, Sir:

- 6 batches completed, 1 running (`bat-icb-007`), 1 failed (`bat-icb-005`).
- 144 migrated, 7 failed, 4 quarantined, 30 pending.
- Failure cluster on **bat-icb-005** with 7 carrier-missing errors (likely a small subset we did not exclude).

Would you like me to retry the failed batch with stricter exclusion, or quarantine and continue?
Quarantine la, takpe. Tapi retry bat-icb-005 dengan additional exclusion list, just so saya boleh tunjuk auditor we tried.
Understood, Sir.

Retry completed: 18 records migrated, 7 quarantined as expected. Audit trail is now complete. Shall I run reconciliation, Sir?
Yes, reconcile and check if totals match. Lepas tu pull audit log, saya nak tunjuk pada manager.
Right away.

Would you like to proceed with the cutover, Sir?
Sat, sebelum cutover boleh take snapshot v9 dulu — preserve evidence. Lepas tu kita finalize cutover.
Understood, Sir.
